description:
Create a new FEATURE. `projectIds` defaults to the current project when omitted.

**HIERARCHY — ALWAYS RESOLVE BEFORE CALLING.** Features live under Epics. Before calling this tool, confirm with the user which `epicId` this feature belongs to. If the user has not told you: (1) ask them directly, or (2) if they name an epic, resolve the id via `epic_list`. When creating MULTIPLE features from a BRD, group them under the correct epic — do not scatter them. Skip epic linking only if the user explicitly says "no epic" or "standalone feature".

`state` and `priority` default to the project-configured defaults when omitted; pass them only when overriding. Backend requires `name`, `estimatedEffort`, `plannedStartDate`, `plannedEndDate`. **`description` must be a DETAILED feature write-up as HTML (NOT markdown) — SQA UI renders it via a Tiptap editor. See the description field docstring for the exact allowed tags and required section structure. One-line summaries are not acceptable.** `customFields` may be omitted — an empty object is sent automatically.

customFields.description: Optional. Empty object `{}` sent automatically when omitted.

        Overview

        Non-Functional Requirements
        • Performance, security, a11y, i18n — quote thresholds verbatim (e.g. < 200ms p95).
        

        Acceptance Signals

epicId.description: Parent epic numeric id. RESOLVE VIA `epic_list` OR ASK THE USER before creating — do not leave a feature parent-less unless the user explicitly says "no epic".

orphan.description: Set true ONLY if the user has explicitly said the feature has no parent epic ("standalone", "no epic"). Required when `epicId` is omitted — the tool refuses otherwise.

priority.description: Optional. Defaults to the project-configured default feature priority when omitted.

state.description: Optional. Defaults to the project-configured default feature state when omitted.

watchList.description: Watch List (the UI email button): emails, full names or numeric userIds to receive notifications. Applied after creation.
